verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is fundamentally API-first — nearly every documented capability (URL/PDF conversion, search, image captioning, custom headers like x-json-schema, x-preset, x-engine, caching, proxy routing) is exposed directly via HTTP endpoints (r.jina.ai, s.jina.ai) rather than gated behind a separate UI, so parity is inherent to the product's design. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation contrasting a dashboard/UI feature set against the API to confirm there is truly no UI-only capability, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe shows 404s) to formally guarantee full API coverage.
